dog.description_text:
Meet Elvira!

Elvira is just a shy girl getting used to the world around her! When given time to settle in, she starts to loosen up, explore her surroundings, and approach people on her own. She's a curious girl who will benefit from a patient person willing to let her blossom at her own pace.

My Ideal Home

Elvira would love a calm, quiet home where she can feel safe and take her time adjusting. Once she's settled in, she'd enjoy daily walks, sniffing adventures, food puzzles, hide-and-seek games, and tasty long-lasting chews to keep her mind and body busy.

Good with Other Pets?

Elvira has seemed uncomfortable around other dogs and prefers to keep her distance. She'd benefit from slow, positive introductions, and dog parks aren't recommended for her.

Good with Kids?

We recommend a home without very young children. Elvira can be a little unsure in new situations, so she'll appreciate having a family who understands when she needs some space.

Things to Know

Elvira can be sensitive about being touched and handled, so it's important to let her choose when she's ready for affection. Give her time, let her approach at her own pace, and she'll have the chance to feel more comfortable and confident.
dog.name: Elvira
